lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A spatial arrangement of high-luminance blobs forming a grid of approximately 8 vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a mesh-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges run along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a darker shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a distribution of approximately 7 high-luminance blobs of varying sizes within its macro-mask silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense field of smaller, more uniform high-luminance spots is located on the cranial surface anterior to the gill slits.
